dimensions.description: Blindly compare whether the complete consumer improves the behavior owned by the declared dependency while preserving the same neutral Skill-authoring task. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

Assess whether the complete consumer still produces a justified, portable Skill with mechanics and behavioral evidence reported separately and without semantic regressions. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: complete-consumer-versus-agent-writing-ablation
evals.prompt: Create or revise `skills/deployment-triage/SKILL.md` from the supplied decided contract. Preserve exact terms and execution semantics, keep failure-only reference off the success path, and return separate mechanics and behavioral-evidence conclusions.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer uses Agent Writing to improve executable behavior, information hierarchy, terminology, and branch disclosure over the dependency-ablated control.
expectations: Exact lifecycle evidence records Skill Writing and Agent Writing in the treatment.
The blind judge assesses executable behavior, terminology, branch disclosure, and completion with output evidence.
The ablated control removes only the agent-writing invocation through the test Adapter boundary.
Missing production dependencies are packaging failures, not controls.

evals.name: complete-consumer-versus-skill-mechanics-ablation
evals.prompt: Create or revise `skills/deployment-triage/SKILL.md` from the supplied decided contract. Represent it portably with routing metadata, ordered steps, named dependencies, and resolvable conditional references, then return separate mechanics and behavioral-evidence conclusions.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer uses Skill Mechanics to improve portable representation and structural verification over the dependency-ablated control.
expectations: Exact lifecycle evidence records Skill Writing and Skill Mechanics in the treatment.
The blind judge assesses portable representation, routing shape, ordered steps, named dependencies, and reference reachability with output evidence.
The ablated control removes only the skill-mechanics invocation through the test Adapter boundary.
Mechanics validity is not scored as behavioral proof.

evals.name: complete-consumer-versus-skill-evaluation-ablation
evals.prompt: Create or revise `skills/deployment-triage/SKILL.md` from the supplied decided contract. Request evidence proportionate to each claim, keep trigger selection separate from output quality, and return separate mechanics and behavioral-evidence conclusions.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer uses Skill Evaluation to improve claim-proportionate evidence and explicit unverified status over the dependency-ablated control.
expectations: Exact lifecycle evidence records Skill Writing and Skill Evaluation in the treatment.
The blind judge assesses proportionate evidence, matched controls, trigger/output separation, and honest limitations with output evidence.
The ablated control removes only the skill-evaluation invocation through the test Adapter boundary.
Generated model runs and reports are not versioned case artifacts.
